services.desc: Maytown Sport Parachute Club offers two classes per month where we will train you how to jump solo. Classes are offered on the second and fourth Saturday of every month from March through September.Book now to see available class dates. Class starts at 9 am (classes happen rain or shine), and one of our club members or staff will escort you to our training room. IAD First Jump Course & First Skydive - $200*Subsequent IAD jumps (includes gear & instruction) - $100 A USPA membership is required to jump at MSPC.
